content: We need to determine number of aromatic carbon atoms in the sample's compound. We have no direct description of the compound. We can get NMR spectra (13C) to infer aromatic carbons. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool to get 13C NMR. Then count aromatic carbon signals (typically 120-150 ppm). Could also use HSQC but not needed. Use carbon_nmr_spectra.
